name: Aerial Views Launcher
description: Opens the Aerial Views app as the screensaver when the Kiosk Satellite screensaver starts, then brings the kiosk back to the front on motion, a face, presence, the wake word or a Home Assistant sensor. Pick the Black screensaver in Kiosk Satellite to avoid any flash.
author: sonic1200

settings.title: Open Aerial Views with the screensaver
settings.description: When the Kiosk Satellite screensaver starts, Aerial Views opens on top.

settings.title: Activity to open
settings.description: As package/activity. The default opens the Aerial Views screensaver directly.

settings.title: Return on motion
settings.description: Uses Kiosk Satellite's motion detection (Settings > Camera). It must keep running in the background: turn on background listening.

settings.title: Return on presence or proximity
settings.description: The device's presence sensor, person detection and proximity sensor.

settings.title: Return on the wake word or a call
settings.description: The wake word, a voice conversation or an incoming intercom call.

settings.title: Home Assistant sensor (optional)
settings.description: The kiosk comes back when this sensor turns on (motion, occupancy, a door...). Works even if the camera stops in the background.

settings.title: Ignore detections after opening
settings.description: Keeps motion right at the start from closing Aerial Views straight away.

settings.title: Return method
settings.description: Auto tries Android, then Shizuku if the kiosk did not come back. Android 10+ needs the Display over other apps permission for Kiosk Satellite, otherwise Shizuku is required.

settings.title: Turn the screen off after
settings.description: After this long in Aerial Views, returns to the kiosk and turns the screen off. 0 = never.

settings.title: Night hours
settings.description: During these hours Aerial Views does not open: the kiosk sleeps instead, like Fully Kiosk's screen off schedule.

settings.title: Turn the screen off when night starts
settings.description: Closes Aerial Views if it is open and turns the screen off. Needs Kiosk Satellite to be allowed to turn the screen off (Device admin), otherwise nothing happens.

settings.title: Turn the screen on when night ends
settings.description: Wakes the screen in the morning. If the screensaver shows, Aerial Views opens again.
